🎥🎬: Lucky

After leaving her criminal past behind, Lucky is determined to build a new life and finally escape the dangerous world she once knew. But just when freedom seems within reach, circumstances force her back into the underground life she desperately tried to leave behind.

With everything on the line, Lucky agrees to take on one final job, hoping it will give her the chance to settle old debts and disappear for good. But returning to familiar territory means facing dangerous people, broken loyalties, and consequences from choices she thought were buried in the past.

Caught between survival and redemption, Lucky must decide how far she is willing to go for a second chance—and whether anyone can truly walk away from their old life.
